A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''scrap dealer''' lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and attempted to sell a [[Unidentified scrap dealer's starship|starship]] that he claimed was the [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|''Leviathan'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Darth Malak]]. The scrap dealer's claims were false, but the ship actually was from the era of the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Wake the Leviathan}}</ref>
